quest.title: Sir Pouncelot Joins the Lot!
quest.description: Your tireless work as cat saviors has seen your great cat guest grow gentle and well-behaved...\nHowever, its mode of dress indicates that it still has quite the story to tell...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Unknown Item #369187 x1, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awww, that's a good kitty, Sir Pouncelot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You better be on your best behavior from now on, okay? Don't go causing trouble now. Hehe, Paimon knows you're a sweet, happy little cat. You'll get along with everyone just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Valerina
dialogues.text: He's so adorable! I just wanna scratch his head and pinch his little cheeks!

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: He does have a certain endearing quality about him... when he's not causing trouble, that is. Hmm, I wonder how he got that injury around his eye...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The traces of the restorative potion indicate that Sir Pouncelot should be in the vicinity.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Sister Rosaria... Ah, and you must be an adventurer. I don't believe we've met...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It appears Sir Pouncelot has taken quite the liking to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo! It's been such a long time! It's super great to see you! But... are you sure you're in the right place?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I'm assuming the Captain of the Investigation Team is here for some important reason?

dialogues.speaker: Valerina
dialogues.text: C—Captain? He's a captain of the Knights of Favonius? An important officer just showed up without warning... and I don't even have any refreshments or snacks to offer!

dialogues.speaker: Valerina
dialogues.text: Please, allow me to explain, Sir. I assure you this shelter is operating under a legitimate business license! All proper procedures have been followed...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Assuming that Albedo has arrived to investigate her business, Valerina frantically searches for the relevant documents while explaining the purpose of the shelter...\n Valerina appears intimidated by the identity of the visitor, unaware that the Investigation Team doesn't handle such inspections...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There's no need to worry. I was simply in the area helping my team address a small issue... Namely, the location of this cat right here.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Not too long ago, "Interim Team Feline: Treatment Case No. 3 — Sir Pouncelot" knocked out the weapons officer who was watching over him. He then fled and disappeared into the city.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We knew we had to recover him as fast as possible. The cat belongs to the Investigation Team, and even bears the insignia of the Knights of Favonius. If he were to wreak havoc across the city... Well, that would hardly be a welcome result for any party involved.

choices.text: So, he actually belongs to the Investigation Team?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're saying Sir Pouncelot is capable of knocking out a knight? And what's with all those official sounding titles you added to his name? Interim... Treatment case something or other... Is there something else you're not telling us?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Ah, well, I suppose I should explain. Two months ago, Sir Pouncelot got lost in the wild and accidentally ingested Whopperflower Nectar. Due to certain effects that are not entirely understood as of yet, the nectar caused him to triple in size.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Triple! Even regular-sized cats can get pretty bold when they're upset... A cat triple the size... Paimon bets even a Hilichurl wouldn't be enough to scare off a cat like that!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: So that's what happened. No wonder he was so anxious.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: For cats... or really any animal that lives in the wild, a larger size doesn't exactly confer many advantages. What it actually does is make their appearance more noticeable and their movements less nimble.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Which, in turn, means living in perpetual danger of exposing themselves to attacks from predators. In other words, it means living in a constant state of fear...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Exactly. When Sir Pouncelot stumbled upon our encampment, he looked quite worse for wear. His entire body was riddled with scars and he appeared exceptionally anxious.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Th—That's awful... I guess he had a good reason for all that swatting earlier, then... If all that had happened to me, I would be afraid of new people and strange animals too...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You don't need to worry too much. The problem has already been solved. I administered a restorative potion to eliminate the alchemical effects of the Whopperflower Nectar, and help him return to a normal size.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Although he still might appear a bit larger than the average cat, his current size, at least, should pose no more threat to his quality of life. While in our care, various knights have been taking turns watching over him.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In light of his feisty demeanor, Klee decided to call him "Sir Pouncelot." We all thought it was quite fitting. We even made him that little scarf as a testament to his time among our ranks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah, Klee and Paimon were totally on the same wavelength with this one! We thought of the exact same name! Great minds really do think alike, hehe...

response.speaker: Sir Pouncelot
response.text: Meow~

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Sir Pouncelot's extreme level of anxiety and caution around people may be a result of residual trauma from the time of his transformation. You could say he was less than friendly towards the weapons and signals officers on our team. Klee wasn't around that much to entertain him either.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: However, it appears Sir Pouncelot has taken quite the liking to you. The knights on my team would never have imagined that he could warm up to people like this.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, they are our dear cat saviors, after all — The famed Honorary Knight and Paimon the Cat Whisperer!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: #No matter how feisty or frightening the cat, after a few minutes with {NICKNAME} and Paimon, they'll be sweet as can be!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If that's the case, then I have a question for you both. Would you be willing to adopt Sir Pouncelot?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, really? But, doesn't he belong to your team?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, we did take him in, but it was simply out of necessity. We were always planning to find him a permanent home after his condition became more stable.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The Investigation Team is no place for a pet, and we are a combat unit, after all.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Any knight he got close to would have to go on assignment eventually. It's hardly appropriate to just leave him at camp, and bringing him on our missions would only frighten him further.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: All good points.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: He's been through quite the ordeal already. For a creature like that, it's best to keep him away from potential triggers. That way, he can slowly recover in peace...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, we could set up a nice, cozy little home for him in the Serenitea Pot. It has everything he could want! And most importantly... no monsters!

response.speaker: Sir Pouncelot
response.text: Meeoww!

choices.text: Great! Welcome to the family, Sir Pouncelot!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you so much, Albedo!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: No need to thank me! If you find yourselves with some time on your hands, maybe you can bring him by the encampment some time. I'm sure my fellow knights would love a chance to see his calmer side.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Th—That was so touching! I can't believe I got to witness such a special moment! I do believe this counts as the Furball Fortress' first successful adoption!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Hey, my veil is not a handkerchief...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It appears you enjoy interacting with small animals, Sister Rosaria. I must admit, I find that a bit surprising...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can also sense that you're an animal lover, Rosaria! You definitely have a way with cats — you just haven't realized it yet. After all, it's not a side of you that comes out very often.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Snowball warmed up to you right from the start! And you were the one that helped Sir Pouncelot calm down back there!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Oh, uh... I didn't really do anything though. I was just... there.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Ah, I've got it! I've learned so many useful tips from our dear cat saviors recently!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I've decided to extend the shelter's trial period for a bit in order to go over what I've learned. With some effort, I hope I can be a cat whisperer too one day. For now, though, I'll settle for cat whisperer... in training, hehe!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: When I open for good, what do you say we run the shelter together, Miss Rosaria? With the two of us, we could rescue every stray in Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, the sister and the whisperer working together... Almost sounds like it was meant to be, hehe!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Oh, well... This errand hasn't proved to be too troublesome. It's light on work and stress. I suppose... I wouldn't be opposed to your suggestion.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I don't know much about rescuing stray animals, but this seems to be quite the milestone. Allow me to offer my congratulations.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If my fellow knights run into any strays, I'll be sure to tell them to send them your way.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Thank you, thank you, thank you! I really can't thank you all enough for your support! Don't worry, there's a generous reward in store for each and every one of you!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: The trial phase of the Furball Fortress could not have been more successful! When we open for good, you all simply must come to the opening ceremony. We'll cut the ribbon together!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that's what Paimon calls a successful commission! Rewarding in more ways than one — Mora, a sense of accomplishment, and, of course, our special friend, Sir Pouncelot! Talk about a win win win!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't wait for the Furball Fortress to open for good!

response.speaker: Sir Pouncelot
response.text: Meow!

choices.text: Awesome! You've got a new home now, Sir Pouncelot!
That would explain the Knights of Favonius symbol...
